Expose fenced Attention APIs over V1 (#187)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-60
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - expose safe current and historical Attention list/detail representations through V1
    - add profile-scoped, scope/idempotency/version/observation-digest fenced resolution directives
    - expose failed-execution cancel-Attention creation without direct active cancellation or provider mutation
    - document the closed OpenAPI union, scopes, problem mappings, examples, and MCP parity
    - persist bounded resolution intent/receipt readback
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all --check`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-api --test contract attention_` (2 passed)
    - `cargo test -p codeon --lib attention` (10 passed; 7 PostgreSQL-dependent tests ignored)
    - package-scoped Cargo check and Clippy for changed crates
    - `just verify` attempted; blocked by unchanged notification persistence type mismatch and Cursor Clippy warning
    - PostgreSQL acceptance not run because an isolated test database was not configured
